subject: Request: trial credit boost for evaluation — Lumenlytics
messages:
From: Samir Patel <samir@lumenlytics.com>
To: support@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 22 Apr 2027 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Self-serve form: request for additional trial credits for eval

Hi Redwood team,

I just signed up (samir@lumenlytics.com) and filled the self-serve evaluation form. We
are trying to run a 48-hour embedding/semantic-search benchmark across ~10M documents and the
initial trial credits ran out faster than expected.

Use case: in-product semantic search + recommendations for a B2B SaaS app (privacy-sensitive PII).
We want to stress test latency and model cost profiles across the Redwood catalog before committing.

Can you approve an extra $500 in evaluation credits or a 7-day extension?

Account: Lumenlytics — goal is to validate throughput on a 4-GPU job and then run a short A/B quality
eval. If there are requirements on redaction or SOC2 evidence, we can supply an NDA or SOC2
contact.

HubSpot ref: 12345/company/67890 (filled on the form).

Thanks — appreciate a fast triage here.

—Samir
Samir Patel
Head of ML Engineering
Lumenlytics
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir@lumenlytics.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Apr 2027 16:35:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Self-serve form: request for additional trial credits for eval

Hi Samir — thanks for the details and welcome to Redwood. I’m Marissa on the PLG team; I
handle quick credit triage for self-serve signups.

Quick answers up front:
- We can usually approve a one-time eval boost for qualifying trials (policy attached).
- Typical approval is between $200–$1,000 depending on scope; $500 is within the usual range.
- We’ll need a short confirmation of the intended model families and an expected token estimate so we
can document spend.

Two quick asks to move forward: 1) which models in the catalog are you planning to run for the
embedding and generation tests (model names are fine), and 2) can you confirm the start date and
approx token/embedding count? If you prefer I can provision the credits now and we’ll reconcile if the
usage deviates significantly.

I’ve looped in Marcus (solutions engineer) to check whether any additional compliance notes are
necessary for your PII use-case. Ben from growth is on cc if we want to convert this to a pilot later.

If you reply with the model names we’ll aim to get the credits applied within 24 hours.

Best,

—Marissa Cole
Account Executive, PLG Growth
Redwood Inference
From: Samir Patel <samir@lumenlytics.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Apr 2027 17:01:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Self-serve form: request for additional trial credits for eval

Marissa — thanks for the quick reply.

Planned models: embed-sim-3-small for embeddings (batching across 64) and rwd-chat-2.7b for a
small generation pass. Expected volume: ~120k embeddings and 300k generated tokens across the run.
Start window: ASAP — ideally tonight PDT but tomorrow morning is fine too.

We have a standard DPA in place; SOC2 contact is privacy@lumenlytics.com (we can share a contact if you
need a direct verification).

If you can provision $500 now that would be great — we’ll keep you posted on usage.

—Samir
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir@lumenlytics.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Apr 2027 18:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Self-serve form: request for additional trial credits for eval

Hi Samir — all set. I approved a $500 evaluation credit boost for Lumenlytics (Deal DL-8421).
You should see the extra credits applied to the account within ~1 hour; I’ve attached our short
free_credits_policy.pdf and a credit_grant_receipt_20270422.pdf stub with the approval reference.

Notes and next steps:
- Grant expires in 14 days from application.
- If usage exceeds the credit window I’ll reach out before applying any additional grants.
- Marcus — flagging the PII question; if we need a SOC2 quick-check can you take the lead?

Samir — please reply to confirm you’ve received the credit and I’ll move this thread to closed. If
you’d like a quick walkthrough of batching/quantization settings that lower cost, Marcus can set up a 20m
screen share.

Thanks and good luck with the benchmark — let us know how the results look.

—Marissa Cole
Account Executive, PLG Growth
Redwood Inference
